screen.traumacraft.drag_to_treat: Click a body part with medicine
message.traumacraft.not_applicable: This item cannot treat that injury
jei.traumacraft.bandage: Stops light bleeding or reduces heavy bleeding to light.
jei.traumacraft.splint: Stabilizes a fracture. The bone recovers gradually while resting. Use in hand to select an unstabilized fracture.
jei.traumacraft.medkit: Restores up to 25 HP to living tissue. Does not stop bleeding or restore destroyed limbs.
jei.traumacraft.sterile_fabric: Clean cloth material used for dressings and medical kits.
jei.traumacraft.herbal_extract: A crafted botanical concentrate used in healing remedies.
jei.traumacraft.antiseptic: A refined medical reagent for emergency kits and injectors.
jei.traumacraft.syringe_body: Crafting component for prepared injection syringes.
jei.traumacraft.medical_polymer: Tough flexible material for braces, tourniquets and cases.
jei.traumacraft.sterile_patch: Restores 10 local HP to a living, damaged part. Does not work on a destroyed (0 HP) part.
jei.traumacraft.compression_wrap: Stops any bleeding on the selected zone and restores 5 local HP.
jei.traumacraft.hemostatic_gel: Stops severe bleeding on any zone, restores up to 10 HP of living tissue.
jei.traumacraft.tourniquet: Stops severe bleeding on an arm or leg only.
jei.traumacraft.fracture_brace: Stabilizes a fracture and restores 10 local HP.
jei.traumacraft.bone_mender: Stabilizes a fracture, restores 25 local HP and grants Absorption I for 10 seconds.
jei.traumacraft.compact_medkit: Restores 18 local HP to one damaged body part above 0 HP.
jei.traumacraft.field_medkit: Restores 42 local HP and stops bleeding.
jei.traumacraft.trauma_kit: First aid: stops bleeding, splints a fracture and restores up to 45 HP of living tissue.
jei.traumacraft.surgical_kit: Restores 15 HP of a destroyed limb, stops bleeding and stabilizes fractures.
jei.traumacraft.recovery_serum: Restores 8 local HP to every body part and grants Regeneration I for 15 seconds.
jei.traumacraft.adrenaline_injector: Grants Speed II and Strength I for 30 seconds.
jei.traumacraft.guardian_injector: Grants Resistance I and Absorption II for 40 seconds.
jei.traumacraft.focus_injector: Grants Haste II and Night Vision for 90 seconds.
jei.traumacraft.endurance_injector: Grants Speed I and Jump Boost II for 60 seconds.
jei.traumacraft.rag_dressing: Stops light bleeding and restores up to 4 HP. Does not stop heavy bleeding.
jei.traumacraft.analgesic_tablets: Temporarily reduces pain. No tissue healing or damage resistance.
jei.traumacraft.medical_pouch: Four medicine slots. Right-click in the main hand to open. An oversized kit reserves a 1×2 column.
jei.traumacraft.oversized_medkit: Large emergency medkit. Restores 60 local HP, treats bleeding and fractures in one part (5 seconds). Occupies a 1x2 column in a medical pouch. Uses one ordinary slot outside the pouch.
body.traumacraft.head: Head
jei.traumacraft.herbal_poultice: Briefly relieves contusion pain and restores a little tissue. Cannot treat fractures, bleeding or destroyed zones.
jei.traumacraft.raw_herbs: Right-click stone or planks to spread. Left-click cells with an empty hand, flint or cobblestone to crush. Sneak + left-click to retrieve partial work.
jei.traumacraft.crushed_herbs: Crush all 16 cells, then left-click to collect. Used in poultices and extract.
tooltip.traumacraft.herbs_help: Right-click a surface; left-click with flint to process.
